versions.changelog:
Major update (more Creator Friendly)
Rebuilt as the record-of-creation layer of the ecosystem; Attribution Engine renders from it, Content ID Guide cites it, with a field-level handoff contract.
Every record field mapped to open standards (C2PA Content Credentials, XMP, IPTC, SPDX, Creative Commons, ISRC/ISWC/IPI/UPC); C2PA and Local Contexts credited with links; the record is a layer over standards, not a competitor.
One-minute version and a five-line text-message form; works offline, on paper, on shared devices, and on metered connections.
Assurance marks on every entry (stated, documented, signed); the record declares its own partiality and carries its own history.
Identity done with care: chosen names only, pseudonym-safe, embedded metadata off by default, collaborators named only with consent, care contributors credited, young creators' details kept out of files.
Legal pass: discoverability warning before the first field; terms captured as documents state them; transfers documented never effected; a credit is not a claim of authorship; contact routing disclaimed for succession; expert disclaimers; every law statement dated to authorship.
Music depth: master and composition layers on every source, ownership as documented, industry identifiers.
Misuse floors: minimal default export, use constraints and training reservation in the record, anonymity respected, record author named, two copies, open format.
Access floors anchored to WCAG 2.2 AAA where a text skill can reach it; official platform and standards sources only, pulled into guidance when verified.
Language revised throughout for care and creativity to safely bloom; part of the OtherPowers Ecosystemic.ai ecosystem.

- Added metadata file (_meta.json) to the project.  
- No changes to core skill documentation or functionality.  
- This update improves project organization and discoverability.

- Initial release of Creator Rights Assistant.
- Enables creators to standardize provenance, attribution, and licensing metadata at the moment of asset creation.
- Introduces the Asset Birth Certificate (ABC), a comprehensive metadata record for origin, authorship, licensing, and attribution details.
- Provides mandatory disclosure clarifying that the tool is for organization, not legal advice or enforcement.
- Offers guidance on attribution formatting for various platforms and supports lifecycle tracking of licenses and rights.
- Designed as an educational and organizational aid to help creators maintain accurate, consistent rights information across their workflows.
